assessment.independenceRationale: Official corporate portal is the primary source; the third-party vector library independently corroborates the same design.

candidate.detailsJudgement: All emblem details survive: swirl strokes, Д monogram, дм letters and internal white gaps are intact in the final Desktop renders on both themes; no clipping, no lost strokes.
candidate.proportionsJudgement: Whole-emblem fit complete in the square cell with small uniform margins; useful size good — recognizable at 24/32/48 px diagnostics; transparency preserved; no backing per policy for a suitable transparent standalone mark.
candidate.rationale: Original untraced vector emblem extracted from the official SDM Bank lockup (corp.sdm.ru/ru/img/logo.svg, 2026-styled portal page). Standalone 'S'-swirl + 'Дм' monogram mark in brand color #012B5D; accompanying wordmark 'СДМБАНК' dropped to satisfy the standalone-mark rule. No raster tracing or embedding.
candidate.role: Standalone bank emblem from the official horizontal lockup; letters Дм are part of the mark itself.
transforms: Selected the emblem-only paths (max x 40.71) from the 170x34 lockup; viewBox tightened to 0 0 41 34; no path geometry edited.
No placement scale/translation needed beyond viewBox crop.
SVGO 1.2.3 (repo svgo.config.mjs, sha256 of config recorded by tool) on a copy: 4261 -> 2391 bytes (43.9%); result selected as final after visual comparison showed identical render.
candidate.variant: Current 2026 official lockup variant; emblem region used unchanged. Transparent standalone mark; no observed circular official avatar, so no backing added.
candidate.visibleDiffExplanation: First addition: the record had no icon.svg, so the diff is absence to a real icon; the emblem itself is unchanged source geometry.

proposals.reason: First addition: no icon.svg exists. Original untraced vector SVG located on the bank's own corporate portal: https://corp.sdm.ru/ru/img/logo.svg, referenced from the login page (corp.sdm.ru/ru/html/login.html, stylesheet loginSDM2026.css indicating 2026 branding). The portal links a RuStore mobile app, supporting current 2026 operating use. The asset is a horizontal lockup (170x34) of the standalone emblem plus lettering; the emblem region (left ~28 units) is the standalone mark for the square cell.

sourceCandidate.rationale: Genuine original vector served by the bank's own corporate domain (corp.sdm.ru, referenced from login.html); pure paths, no raster embedding, untraced crisp lockup with brand color #012B5D. Horizontal lockup; standalone emblem region (left ~28 units) is the mark for the square cell.

sources.observation: Official login page of the bank's corporate portal links logo.svg directly; stylesheet loginSDM2026.css names 2026 branding and the portal advertises the bank's mobile app, supporting current operating use. www.sdm.ru serves a JS loader to plain fetch, so corp.sdm.ru is the usable official surface.
Third-party vector library card (EPS/CDR/AI zip) corroborates the logo design; kept as corroboration only, not used as source bytes.
